name: [NEW CARS] Teach Your Sister How To Drive! 🎙️
desc:
🚗 Teach your sister how to drive... if you survive! 😬

Mia just got her learner's permit and YOU are in the passenger seat. She is a TERRIBLE driver. Tell her when to turn, brake, slow down, honk and buckle up before she crashes into cones, cops and trucks!

🎙️ GOT VOICE CHAT? USE YOUR MIC! Hold SPACE and just SAY it: "turn left!", "slow down!", "STOP!!" and Mia does it... mostly. 🙄
🎮 No mic? No problem! Hold Q (or tap TELL MIA) to pick a command.

🏁 Survive every lesson: parking lots, cone courses, city traffic and even a police chase!
⭐ Pass lessons, earn coins and paint your car
😂 She talks back. A LOT.

New lessons coming soon! 👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite so you don't miss them!

llm.loop: ride as passenger while NPC sister drives -> give commands by voice or menu -> survive the lesson -> earn coins -> unlock cars and paint
llm.objectives: pass every driving lesson without crashing
llm.instructions: Tell Mia when to turn/brake/honk by voice chat (hold space) or menu; survive lessons up to police chase
unique: voice-chat commands control an NPC driver
llm.thumbnails: cartoon sister driving terribly, BRAKE!! text, car on fire
llm.complexity_notes: speech recognition hookup, scripted NPC driving and dialogue
